# has verification status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasVerificationStatus`](gmeow-hasVerificationStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasVerificationStatus>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The categorical outcome of a verification result. Non-functional: a single result may carry multiple status interpretations (e.g. 'verified but expired').

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md) -> [`gmeow:VerificationStatus`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationStatus.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasVerificationStatus`](gmeow-hasVerificationStatus.md) from [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md) to [`gmeow:VerificationStatus`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationStatus.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach the categorical verdict — verified, failed, expired, revoked, policy-failed, finality-pending — to a [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md), naming one or more [`gmeow:VerificationStatus`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationStatus.md) individuals.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the ledger settlement state (that is [`gmeow:finalityStatus`](gmeow-finalityStatus.md) / [`gmeow:LedgerFinalityStatus`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerFinalityStatus.md)) and avoid forcing one status — a result may be both verified and expired, so it is non-functional.

### How to use

- Reference one or more [`gmeow:VerificationStatus`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationStatus.md) individuals; combine 'verified' with 'expired' or 'finality pending' on a single result when both apply rather than picking one.

### Examples

- ex:verifyOutcome [`gmeow:hasVerificationStatus`](gmeow-hasVerificationStatus.md) [`gmeow:verificationStatusVerified`](../individuals/gmeow-verificationStatusVerified.md).
